mandatoryCriteria: Single-owner workspace atomicity: Creating a workspace atomically sets owner_id = actor.id in PostgreSQL transaction
Mandatory Idempotency-Key: POST /api/v1/workspaces requires valid Idempotency-Key (16-128 ASCII chars), rejecting missing/invalid with 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED
Idempotency replay: Subsequent identical request returns HTTP 201 with replayed: true and exact identical response payload without duplicate workspace creation
Idempotency conflict: Duplicate key with divergent payload returns HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
Concurrent duplicate-key safety: Parallel identical requests handle ON CONFLICT gracefully without 500 error
Receipt expiration: Expired idempotency receipts (expires_at <= NOW()) allow clean reuse of the key for a fresh mutation
Authentication enforcement: Unauthenticated requests return HTTP 401 UNAUTHORIZED
Input validation: Invalid timezone or empty workspace name returns HTTP 422 VALIDATION_ERROR with structured issues
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Workspace creation, single-owner transaction atomicity, idempotency receipt store and concurrency replay, and workspace listing in Node and Cloudflare Worker runtimes. Out-of-scope: Multi-workspace enterprise consolidation and billing.
